items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: No, they didn't influence me, but I like what they were doing... when I first heard Max really drop those bombs and things like that was with Dizzy's big band

ctx.x: Oh yeah. Yeah, Diz called me, said, Cozy, our drummer--what was his name--said he never showed. Can you make it? I said, yeah. He said drums are already here, so I didn't have to bring any drums. He said bring your sticks and brushes. So I did.
Did what people like Kenny Clark and Max

No, they didn't influence me, but I like what they were doing, you know, because when I first heard Max really drop those bombs and things like that was with Dizzy's big band, and he sound very good in that band. When I heard Kenny Clark he was with MJQ, he sound very good because they were organized. I knew that I wouldn't be able to do it.
